# Instrument Sans — local Latin subset

The Instrument Sans Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1, bundled beside
this file. Copied on 2026-10-28 from the WOFF2 face embedded in the Atelier
identity sheet (v1.0), which carries Google Fonts' Latin variable subset
(`wght 400..700`, `wdth 75..100`). The browser makes no runtime font request.

- Upstream: https://github.com/Instrument/instrument-sans
- Used by the identity interface role (`--font-ui` in `gui/identity.css`).
